texts.label: text
texts.orig: I’m thrilled to announce that I’ll be hosting a very special one-day conference this fall in San Francisco, on Thursday, October 24. I’ve curated a speaker lineup of product and growth leaders who I deeply respect, and we’re aiming to have 1,000 senior product people in attendance. Want to be one of them?
texts.text: I’m thrilled to announce that I’ll be hosting a very special one-day conference this fall in San Francisco, on Thursday, October 24.
